dialogues.jp: 幼い足音が二組。弾んで、楽しげな……。
dialogues.en:
I hear the footsteps of two young children. It sounds fun
and light......
dialogues.text:
I hear the footsteps of two young children. It sounds fun
and light......

dialogues.jp:
男の子が振り返る。楽しげな表情。幼い萌先輩
の手を引いて……。
dialogues.en:
The boy turned around with a joyful expression. He was
pulling young Moe's hand......
dialogues.text:
The boy turned around with a joyful expression. He was
pulling young Moe's hand......

dialogues.jp: 満面の笑みで応える幼い先輩。
dialogues.en: She answered with a big smile.
dialogues.text: She answered with a big smile.

dialogues.jp: そんな笑顔、俺だって見たこともなくて……。
dialogues.en: I've never seen a big smile like that on her......
dialogues.text: I've never seen a big smile like that on her......

dialogues.jp:
二人は走り続ける。きっと、どこか楽しい場所
に向かっているのだ。
dialogues.en:
The two continued to run. They're probably heading somewhere
fun.
dialogues.text:
The two continued to run. They're probably heading somewhere
fun.

dialogues.jp:
公園ばっかりじゃない。遊べる場所は、もっと
他にもたくさんあるのだと、そう男の子は教え
てあげたいのだ。
dialogues.en:
The boy's trying to tell her that the park isn't the only
place they could have fun.
dialogues.text:
The boy's trying to tell her that the park isn't the only
place they could have fun.

dialogues.jp: 二人は走っていく。脇目もふらず……。
dialogues.en: The two continued to run without looking back......
dialogues.text: The two continued to run without looking back......

dialogues.jp:
唐突に襲いかかってきた胸騒ぎに、心臓が止ま
りそうになる。
dialogues.en: My heart almost stopped, I felt tremendous fear.
dialogues.text: My heart almost stopped, I felt tremendous fear.

dialogues.en: But my voice isn't reaching them.
dialogues.text: But my voice isn't reaching them.

dialogues.jp:
それでも声は届かない。やっぱり二人は一散に
走っている。
dialogues.en: They still don't hear me. They continued to run.
dialogues.text: They still don't hear me. They continued to run.

dialogues.en: They were running without looking around......
dialogues.text: They were running without looking around......

dialogues.jp: お互いの、手の平だけを感じて……。
dialogues.en: All they care about was the hand they were holding......
dialogues.text: All they care about was the hand they were holding......

dialogues.jp: そこから先の光景は本当にスローモーションだ。
dialogues.en: Everything was in slow motion after that.
dialogues.text: Everything was in slow motion after that.

dialogues.jp: 飛び出してしまった先輩。
そんな先輩をかばうようにして、男の子が……。
dialogues.en: The boy tried to save her and......
dialogues.text: The boy tried to save her and......

dialogues.jp: たぶん、何か重たい物が吹っ飛ばされたような。
dialogues.en: ......It sounded like something heavy being blown away.
dialogues.text: ......It sounded like something heavy being blown away.

dialogues.jp: それに被さるように、それとは別の音。
dialogues.en: I heard another sound overlapping with that one.
dialogues.text: I heard another sound overlapping with that one.

dialogues.jp:
猛禽類か何かが鳴いているような、長く尾を引
く、金属的な悲鳴。
dialogues.en:
It sounded like the scream of a rabid animal. It was a long
loud scream.
dialogues.text:
It sounded like the scream of a rabid animal. It was a long
loud scream.

dialogues.jp:
匂いが漂ってくる。鼻の奥までに突き刺さって
くる、刺激の強い匂いだ。
dialogues.en: I also smell something. It was a strong, sharp smell.
dialogues.text: I also smell something. It was a strong, sharp smell.

dialogues.jp: ブレーキ。間に合わなかった、ブレーキ……。
dialogues.en: The brake didn't make it in time......
dialogues.text: The brake didn't make it in time......

dialogues.jp:
誰か、人が倒れている。打ち捨てられたように、
身体を丸めている。
dialogues.en:
Someone was lying on the street. He was balled up as if he
was dumped like garbage.
dialogues.text:
Someone was lying on the street. He was balled up as if he
was dumped like garbage.

dialogues.jp: 地面が黒く濡れているのは──血？
dialogues.en: The ground was covered with dark fluid...... Is that blood?
dialogues.text: The ground was covered with dark fluid...... Is that blood?

dialogues.jp: そして、その傍らで泣いている──萌先輩。

萌先輩は、男の子の頭を抱え込んで、しくしく
と泣いていた……。
dialogues.en: Moe was crying while holding the boy's head......
dialogues.text: Moe was crying while holding the boy's head......

dialogues.jp: 悲しい夢を見た。交通事故の夢だ。
dialogues.en: I saw a sad dream. It was a dream about an accident.
dialogues.text: I saw a sad dream. It was a dream about an accident.
